description: This source file defines the CheckOutEvents class which contains methods for handling various checkout-related operations in an e-commerce platform, such as page navigation, order creation, payment processing, tax calculation, and validation. It interacts with shopping cart objects, services, and entity models to manage the checkout flow and order lifecycle.

classes.name: CheckOutEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to manage and facilitate the checkout process in an e-commerce application built on the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: cartNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the shopping cart is not empty; returns 'success' if cart items exist, otherwise sets an error message and returns 'error'.

methods.name: setCheckOutPages
methods.description: Handles the transition between checkout pages based on user input and cart state, including setting shipping addresses, options, payments, and order creation.

methods.name: determineInitialCheckOutPage
methods.description: Determines the initial checkout page to display based on whether shipping applies and sets cart shipment methods accordingly.

methods.name: setCheckOutError
methods.description: Gets the current checkout page from request parameters, used for error handling.

methods.name: setQuickCheckOutOptions
methods.description: Calculates tax and sets checkout options quickly, used in quick checkout flow.

methods.name: setPartialCheckOutOptions
methods.description: Sets checkout options in a partial or step-wise manner during the checkout process.

methods.name: setCartShipToCustomerParty
methods.description: Sets the 'ship to' customer party ID on the shopping cart based on request parameters.

methods.name: checkPaymentMethods
methods.description: Validates available payment methods in the cart before proceeding.

methods.name: getSelectedPaymentMethods
methods.description: Collects and returns the user's selected payment methods from request parameters.

methods.name: setCheckOutOptions
methods.description: Sets checkout options including shipping, payment, and billing details based on request data.

methods.name: checkoutValidation
methods.description: Performs validation to ensure required payment and shipping methods are selected based on cart and order type.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates an order using the current shopping cart, invoking the createOrder service, and sets order-related attributes.

methods.name: calcTax
methods.description: Triggers tax calculation for the shopping cart.

methods.name: explodeOrderItems
methods.description: Determines if order items should be exploded into multiple lines based on product store settings.

methods.name: checkShipmentNeeded
methods.description: Checks if shipment is required based on the cart's contents and store settings.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Processes payment for the current cart, including handling success and failure responses.

methods.name: checkOrderDenylist
methods.description: Checks the order against a deny list, returning error or fail if applicable.

methods.name: failedDenylistCheck
methods.description: Handles failing the deny list check, invalidating session if needed.

methods.name: checkExternalCheckout
methods.description: Checks if external checkout (e.g., PayPal) is involved based on store settings.

methods.name: checkExternalPayment
methods.description: Validates external payment processing for an order.

methods.name: finalizeOrderEntry
methods.description: Finalizes various order entry steps, including shipping, options, and payment, and determines the next step in checkout.

methods.name: determineNextFinalizeStep
methods.description: Determines the next checkout step in the process based on cart state, user login, and request parameters.

methods.name: finalizeOrderEntryError
methods.description: Returns a generic error page if finalizeOrderEntry encounters an error.

methods.name: determineBillingAccountAmount
methods.description: Calculates the amount to charge to a billing account, respecting available balance and input.

methods.name: createReplacementOrder
methods.description: Creates a replacement order based on an existing order, including adjustments and item associations.
